subject: Orion Labs — next steps: demo + dedicated GPU sizing

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Orion Labs — next steps: demo + dedicated GPU sizing

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the thorough discovery walk through. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive and the dedicated capacity sizing call: 

Recap from today's call:
- Primary use case: real-time audio transcription + semantic search for voice logs (low-latency reqs for playback).
- Current traffic: ~200 concurrent transcription sessions, peak batch re-processing at night.
- Must-haves: P95 token latency < 80ms on typical 2–3k token requests; audit logs and customer-managed keys.

What we propose for next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (demo + model behavior) — 60m with our solutions engineer to show an end-to-end flow.
2) Dedicated capacity sizing session (throughput & latency focus) — 60m with infra + ML infra leads to map QPS/concurrency to GPU pool sizing.

Suggested windows (Pacific time):
- Tue May 26: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed May 27: 14:00–15:00 PT

Could you confirm which slot works, or propose two alternatives? For the sizing call we have a short intake spreadsheet (attached: sizing-template.xlsx) — if you can fill the highlighted fields ahead of the meeting (expected QPS, average/peak input lengths, and concurrency profile) it will make the session much higher signal.

Agenda for sizing call (draft):
- Quick intro + goals (5m)
- Workload profile and constraints (10m)
- Throughput & latency targets + SLOs (10m)
- Redwood pool sizing recommendations (20m)
- Rollout and fallbacks (10m)
- Action items and next steps (5m)

Ben and Markus are looped in to drive the sizing recommendations. If you want to include your infra/security folks we can invite them to the sizing session.

Thanks — attaching the intake spreadsheet and a short checklist.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Appreciate the recap — that captures it well. We definitely want to proceed with both items (demo + sizing). A couple of notes from our side:
- Please include our infra lead Carlos (cc'd) on the sizing call — he will have the detailed QPS and infra constraints.
- We also need a short conversation about data residency and encryption before committing to Dedicated; ideally have someone from Security join the sizing call.

Regarding scheduling, the Tue/Wed slots you proposed are tight for our team. Could we do: 
- Fri May 28: 11:00–12:00 PT instead?

We'll aim to complete the intake spreadsheet, but can Carlos fill the parts that require infra access if that's easier.

Thanks Samantha — Fri May 28 11:00–12:00 PT works on our side. I’ll book the slot and send a calendar invite.

I've attached the sizing-template.xlsx again and added a brief pre-call checklist in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSizingDocs — please drop the filled spreadsheet there or reply to this thread.

Quick ask for Carlos/security to help complete:
- Expected peak QPS (requests/sec) and typical/90th/99th percentile input lengths (tokens).
- Target latency SLO (P95/P99) and how you measure (end-to-end vs inference-only).
- Any hard constraints (VPC, KMS, egress, region preference).

What we'll cover in the Fri session (concrete):
- Confirm workload numbers (we'll use them to model throughput)
- Map to model family / instance types and projected token cost
- Provide recommended GPU pool sizes + autoscaling thresholds
- Outline fallbacks (cheaper variants, cross-region routing) if capacity constrained

Ben and Markus — can you take point on sizing models and bring a rough cost estimate?

Thanks — invite incoming.

Best,
Naomi
